items.title: Judge denies xAI’s request to block Minnesota ban on ‘nudify’ apps
items.summary: Despite a lawsuit from xAI, a Minnesota ban on apps that allow users to “nudify” images can move forward.

items.title: YouTuber Hank Green says his AI usage is ‘not healthy’
items.summary: Green offered a remarkable apology, saying that "the level of dopamine that I've been getting from interacting with LLMs ... is not healthy for me or good for the world."

items.title: Sam Altman is still making the case for parenting via ChatGPT
items.summary: OpenAI's CEO seemed excited to share a "cool use case" for parents.

items.title: This $9 key physically locks your most addictive apps
items.summary: This $9 NFC key requires you to physically scan it to unlock distracting apps on your phone.

items.title: Ten advances in mathematics and theoretical computer science
items.summary: OpenAI shares new results on long-standing open problems in mathematics and theoretical computer science, including advances in geometry, cryptography, and complexity.
